purpose: The visitors' open demo auction: anyone may bid with PEAL-T from the demo faucet, using a guest account in the browser
terms: 50 fUSD for PEAL-T, limits 0.50 to 2.25 PEAL-T per fUSD in 8 steps, bond 1 PEAL-T, at most 20 bids, committee 2 of 3

liveGuestProof.what: A guest account driven through the production build (vercel.json headers and rewrites, via npm run web:preview) in headless Chromium: register the ML-DSA-87 key, claim 1,000 PEAL-T in a 1-tx window, then approve + commitBid of a bid sealed in the browser in a 2-tx window

funding.note: test funding only, by decision of the orchestrator: 2 QOR from the deployer; real visitors fund themselves from the faucet

liveGuestProof.bid: 10 fUSD at most 1.25 PEAL-T each: escrow 12.5 + bond 1 PEAL-T

settlement.what: Settled on 23 November 2026 after bidding closed with 3 visitor bids (all from guest accounts made in the page). Members 1 and 2 released with npm run testnet -- settle; member 3 released with its own daemon, so finalize could run before the release deadline. A fresh guest account then pressed Finalize and Pay out every bid and the issuer on the results page, served as Vercel serves it (npm run web:preview).
commands: npm run testnet -- settle 0x9A98Fc3b3B5078Bd22bAE5fb937395Ba1AE8c7B4 (close, two releases, openBids)
results page: Finalize, then Pay out every bid and the issuer (guest 0xb074211AaA6C854C5b77CD0CBBbE3DD99ED04eba)
settlement.outcome: 3 bids opened (10 fUSD at most 1.25, 1 fUSD at most 0.50, 1 fUSD at most 0.50 PEAL-T per fUSD); undersubscribed (12 of 50 fUSD), so it cleared at the reserve, 0.50 PEAL-T per fUSD: 12 fUSD bought back for 6 PEAL-T, the unsold 38 fUSD returned to the issuer
settlement.audit: npm run testnet -- audit 0x9A98Fc3b3B5078Bd22bAE5fb937395Ba1AE8c7B4: all 3 ML-DSA-87 release signatures verified off chain with @qorechain/pqc against keys from pqcKeyStatus; every bid reopened from the stored shares agrees with the contract (audit passed); the results page's Check it in this browser gives the same
